_comment: Hand corrections, checked against the page images of the HathiTrust scan. 'pages' edits the page text before parsing (scripts/extract_pages.py); 'acts' edits parsed acts, found by a snippet of their text (scripts/organize_text.py).

pages.note: the margin gives the date of the letter copied (20 décembre 1611)
